items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I'm positive of that because I know him. I know him just like I know my hand.

ctx.x: I hope you don't mind me saying that. It's a very unbelievable story. But it's true. Peter Weistraugh is famous and Alan Shaw is famous. And he says they are both the same man. One of the same.

I don't know. It's one of the same. But you are really sure? I'm positive of that because I know him. I know him just like I know my hand. Yeah. See? He recorded for one company and one name and recorded for the next company and another name. Yes, maybe.
See? I don't know about Peter Weistraugh.
